_comment: Boundary rules, enforced by arch.py and by `python check.py --only arch`.
This file is the source of truth for ALLOWED dependencies; the mermaid
diagram in ARCHITECTURE.md is generated from this plus the actual code.
Paths are relative to src/ (the Godot project). Gate scripts and docs live
at the repo root and are not part of the game's dependency graph.
A module absent from `modules` is drawn but not constrained, so you can
add directories freely and tighten them later. At involvement 'module' or
above, an undeclared module means structure was built without approval.
module_depth 2 means scripts/logic is a module and scripts/logic/combat
is folded into it. Raise it if your tree gets deeper.

tools.description: headless validators run by the gate, not shipped in the game

type_boundary._note: Which directories must stay fully typed (interior) and which are allowed loose containers because their job is converting external data (boundary). Rename or add freely to match your layout; the types check reads this, so reorganising into feature folders does not require editing a gate file.
